title: tc-validity-badge
description:
Evidence freshness as a band that decays with age, plus contested and superseded marks – a badge, or a margin
strip for a document's paragraphs.

mode.description: "badge" – the mark and the band in words; "strip" – one bar per paragraph down a document's margin

observed.description: When the evidence was observed or published: epoch ms, an ISO date string or a Date

profile.description: How fast it decays: "fast", "standard", "slow", "lasting", or your own band boundaries in days

band.description: The band, set outright – `observed` and the profile are then ignored

contested.description: Other evidence disputes it: a dashed ring round the mark and the word "Contested"

superseded.description: Something newer replaces it: the mark turns gray and the badge says "Superseded" first

changed.description: The source has changed since it was used (the app compares what was relied on with what is there now): a blue dot on the mark and the words "Changed since used"

now.description: The moment the age is counted to, in epoch ms – defaults to when the element connected

compact.description: Badge: only the mark, with its words in a tooltip and for screen readers

hideAge.description: Badge: leave out the age ("8 mo. ago")

bandLabels.description: The words for the bands – your own vocabulary in place of High, Good, Aging and Stale

contestedLabel.description: The word for a contested piece of evidence

supersededLabel.description: The word for a superseded piece of evidence

changedLabel.description: The words for a source that has changed since it was used

changedNote.description: What a changed source means and what to do – said after the band, and in the tooltip; empty leaves it out

subjectLabel.description: What screen readers call the evidence: "Aging evidence, observed 8 months ago"

items.description: Strip: one entry per paragraph, in document order

for.description: Strip: the id of the document whose paragraphs the bars line up with; unset stacks the bars on their own

selector.description: Strip: which children of the `for` document count as paragraphs (a selector, default every child element)

stripLabel.description: Strip: the name of the list of bars

paragraphLabel.description: Strip: what an item without a `label` is called, before its number

ValidityProfileName.description: Built-in decay profiles – fast: hours and days (prices, status, news) · standard: weeks and months · slow: years (reference material) · lasting: never decays

ValidityProfile.description: The band boundaries, as an age in days: younger than `high` is high, than `good` good, than `aging` aging; older is stale

observed.description: When the evidence was observed or published

band.description: The band, set outright – `observed` and the profile are then ignored

changed.description: The source has changed since it was used – the app compares what was relied on with what is there now

label.description: Strip: what the paragraph is called in its tooltip and to screen readers (default "Paragraph 2")

ValidityInfo.description: What a piece of evidence says about its freshness – one paragraph of a strip, or a source in tc-claim-answer

ValidityTime.description: A moment: epoch ms, an ISO date string or a Date
